description: Get proprietary LeanScale benchmark data on a topic — drawn from field studies across a panel of B2B software companies and from numbers cited on the podcast. Covers GTM tech stacks, AI adoption in GTM, RevOps headcount and investment ratios, and Series B/C fundraise timing. Use when someone asks 'what's normal', 'what do other companies do', or wants a number to compare against.

topic.description: The metric or area, e.g. 'RevOps headcount ratio', 'CRM adoption', 'time to Series B'.

name: get_benchmark
